items.title: Reducedness of a local ring, its henselization and its strict henselization are equivalent
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that reducedness of a local ring is equivalent to reducedness of its henselization and of its strict henselization. The statement carries a slogan recording that reducedness passes to the henselizations. The proof notes that the two maps are faithfully flat, so one direction follows from descent of reducedness, and for the converse uses that the henselizations are filtered colimits of etale, hence smooth, algebras, so that reducedness ascends from the ring.
